decisions.reason: The enclosed laser workstation line extends the firm's established laser offer, has several models and fits its single-source strategy, and with no shortfall against aspirations and enough slack in a large firm, there is no trigger for dropping it after only one year.

The thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core business, already has its own product page, and adds little incremental cost while completing the technology-per-surface portfolio, so management would keep it while results are still being judged against aspirations.

The piezo inkjet printer complements thermal inkjet for other substrates and applications, is prominently presented, and relies on in-house development and service capabilities, so a large firm with slack would carry it beyond its first year without problemistic search.
